“LITE” is the new single from Dallas rapper BigXthaPlug featuring Atlanta rapper Belly Gang Kushington. The official music video brings together BigXthaPlug’s bass-heavy Texas rap and Southern hip-hop sound with Belly Gang Kushington’s melodic Atlanta style, connecting two rising voices from the current Southern rap scene. Covering New Green Lantern Lanterns Episode 6 Trailer Breakdown and Easter Eggs. Footage from Episode 7 and Episode 8 Finale. DCU Batman References What Really Happened To Hal Jordan, How Guy Gardner Becomes Green Lantern, where Guy Gardner's Green Lantern Ring Comes From. Hal Jordan vs John Stewart Ending, Why John Stewart Rejects The Green Lantern Corps. Zoe Manhunter Ending Explained. Why Zoe Is the Manhunter, Ending Explained, Sinestro Explains The Yellow Lantern Power of Fear. Hal Jordan and Sinestro's Master Plan. Why The Guardians of OA are lying. Yellow Lantern Corps, the prophecy of Blackest Night and the War of Light. What happened to Sinestro, why Lanterns is setting up the Manhunters and the secret history of the Guardians of OA and the other emotional spectrum like yellow lanterns, red lanterns and more. How Guy Gardner Got His Green Lantern Ring. 

New Episodes, Hal Jordan vs Sinestro. Lanterns Season 1, story and plot, how it connects to the Superman 2 Man of Tomorrow Movie and other upcoming DC Movies. Manhunters Explained. Wider ramifications for future DCU Movies. 

James Gunn DC Movies New Justice League Announcement, Canceled DC Movies and TV Shows recently. Zack Snyder and James Gunn meeting. Superman 2, Green Lantern HBO First Look, Teen Titans Movie announcement. The new Batman and other new DC movies & tv shows.

Lanterns is supposed to run for multiple seasons, and help to build out the cosmic side of the DCU like the Supergirl Movie and other future space based dc movies and tv shows. There will be other major DC characters cameo scenes on the show, Nathan Fillion Guy Gardner, other green lanterns, Oa and the Oans. In addition to Sinestro and  other comic book characters.

David Corenswet Superman, Rachel Brosnahan Lois Lane Explained. Batman Brave and the Bold Teaser and the New Batman will be announced next year. Batman Brave and the Bold Teaser and the New Batman will be announced next year. Nathan Fillion Green Lantern, Hawkgirl, Mr Terrific and more new Justice League characters. Why The New Justice League is based more on the Animated Justice League Team.

Henry Cavill Superman Future Plans, Deleted Scenes. Lots more DC and Marvel Trailers coming, Avengers Doomsday Trailer, X-Men 2028 Teasers and More Spider-Man videos soon too!

snippet.description:
The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping – in theaters & IMAX November 20. 

Subscribe to the LIONSGATE YouTube Channel for the latest movie trailers, clips, and more: https://bit.ly/2Z6nfym 

https://www.instagram.com/thehungergames 
https://www.facebook.com/TheHungerGamesMovie 
https://www.threads.com/@thehungergames 
https://x.com/TheHungerGames 
https://www.tiktok.com/@hungergamesofficial 

#TheHungerGames

From acclaimed director Francis Lawrence, THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING follows sixteen-year-old Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) from District 12, beginning on the morning of the reaping for the 50th Annual Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell, the biggest Games yet with twice as many tributes. 

Set in the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, the story follows Haymitch into the arena, where he forms an unlikely alliance with fellow tribute Maysilee Donner (Mckenna Grace) and joins a coalition determined to challenge the Capitol’s control under President Snow (Ralph Fiennes). As the competition unfolds, Haymitch risks everything to take down the Games from within the arena — setting in motion the rebellion that will change Panem forever.

Based on Suzanne Collins’ best-selling novel, THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING also stars Jesse Plemons, Glenn Close, Kieran Culkin, Elle Fanning, Maya Hawke, Whitney Peak, and Kelvin Harrison Jr. Produced by Nina Jacobson, Brad Simpson and Francis Lawrence. Screenplay by Billy Ray and Michael Lesslie.

snippet.title: TYSON | Official Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
TYSON is a raw four-part documentary that peels back the curtain on Mike Tyson’s explosive life, from a brutal Brooklyn childhood and a meteoric rise to heavyweight glory to the addiction, jail time, public breakdowns, and infamous ear bite that almost ended it all. Told unfiltered in Tyson’s own words, with never-before-seen material and rare access to his family, friends, and foes, it’s an intimate portrait of greatness, collapse, and a man still confronting the cost of his legacy.

snippet.title: I have some really bad news...
snippet.description:
🎮 Official Mighty Mike Plays merch:
https://mightymikeplays.com/

I have decided to turn off comments on this channel moving forward. At the end of the day, this is a child’s gaming channel meant to be a fun, safe space. Recently, the comment section became way too aggressive over our use of AI tools for design creation. 

People are claiming this channel is a "scam" unless I use a GoFundMe or accept charity, which makes zero sense. I have been completely transparent and even uploaded the credit card balance as proof of the $118k ad spend. 

Because the comments have become so toxic, I am shutting them down. I will not expose a child to that kind of environment. We are here to enjoy gaming, and keeping the comments off is the best way to protect the peace of this channel. Thank you to those who actually support us.

I will turn comments back on a few weeks once everything calms down.

On this channel, you’ll find long-form video essays about gaming’s biggest stories from studio collapses and corporate greed to the creative risks that still push the medium forward. I break down industry trends, publisher decisions, and the economics behind how games are made, marketed, and sold.

They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). snippet.title: LCS Playoffs | SEN vs SR | Elimination Gauntlet
snippet.description:
The 2026 LCS Summer Split features a best-of-three round-robin regular season, ensuring more games, deeper rivalries, and a clear competitive arc from Week 1 to Finals. At the end of the regular season, the top six teams advance to a double-elimination playoff bracket that mirrors the Spring Split Structure. Every series matters, and every adjustment counts. The stakes are high, as the top two teams qualify for the 2026 League of Legends World Championship, hosted here in North America, to represent the LCS against the world’s best.



In 2026, the LCS Fantasy app becomes a comprehensive hub for fans. Schedules, standings, content, and fantasy integration all live in one place, making it easier than ever to follow the league and compete with your friends. We’re building this as a true home for LCS fans everywhere, whether you’re tuning in every weekend or tracking every stat between matches. Let us know what you think!



Catch the LCS every Saturday and Sunday (and some Fridays!):

Games begin at 1PM PT / 3PM CT / 4PM ET



League of Legends Championship Series teams include Cloud9 Kia, FlyQuest, Team Liquid Alienware, Dignitas, Shopify Rebellion, LYON, Sentinels, and Disguised.

and last but not least...sloth!! this track is def one of my favorites, so i hope you all enjoy it!! i had so so much fun writing and conceptualization alot of alice with angelfaise, so i really wanna give a special shoutout to them!! alice is their daughter as much as shes mine!!

FAQ:
Hey guys! I've seen a question appear a few times about the Faz token and what that means for this theory. I'm going to address that here without spoiling the video. So if you know, you know. The token date is a good point. But even so, it doesn't actually change the order of events at all. It just shifts the dates in this theory slightly.

18:56 The Mangle Problem

24:29 The Incident

snippet.title: Brawl Stars x Duolingo
snippet.description:
Brawl Stars is getting a new Boss Fight: Duo! Brawl Stars and Duolingo are teaming up for an in-app collaboration featuring a new game mode and plenty of rewards.

How it works (Brawl Stars):
• Play the Duo Boss Fight game mode, live in Brawl Stars from September 19th through October 1st
• Defeat Duo by answering language questions and earn rewards by completing the community goals and playing the new game mode

How it works (Duolingo):
• Start your 7-day quest between September 19th and September 30th, then complete a lesson each day to progress
• Unlock Brawl Stars rewards at key milestones: Chaos Drops on Day 1, a Duo-themed cosmetic bundle on Day 4, and Legendary Brawler Spike on Day 7!

Download the latest versions of both apps to participate!
